figurative_meaning_bn: সহচরশব্দ; আতিশয্যবর্জিত কিন্তু শোভন, সুচারু ও সুন্দর
figurative_meaning_en: A rhyming synonym; free from excess but beautiful, graceful, and elegant
example_sentences_in_english: Her outfit is spick and span and attractive.
The house has been decorated in a neat and elegant way.
note: This is a common reduplicative idiom in Bengali for describing tidy elegance without ostentation.
